_comment: Hand-edited overrides read by pipeline/01-build-maps.py. 'parts' fixes a mesh's concept when its OBJ header is blank and the smallest IS-A concept is a tie. 'systems' sets a mesh's display system when no rule in system-rules.json reaches it, or when the display grouping should differ from the rule result. Every entry needs a reason.
